''''' SIAM Journal on Discrete Mathematics''''' is a [[peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[mathematics journal]] published quarterly by the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] (SIAM). The journal includes articles on pure and applied [[discrete mathematics]]. It was established in 1988, along with the ''[[SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications]]'', to replace the ''[[SIAM Journal on Algebraic and Discrete Methods]]''. The journal is indexed by ''[[Mathematical Reviews]]'' and [[Zentralblatt MATH]]. Its 2009 [[Mathematical Citation Quotient|MCQ]] was 0.57. According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2016 [[impact factor]] of 0.755.<ref>{{cite book |year=2017 |chapter=SIAM Journal on Discrete Mathematics |title=[[Journal Citation Reports|2016 Journal Citation Reports]] |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition=Social Sciences |series=[[Web of Science]]}}</ref>

Although its official ISO abbreviation is ''SIAM J. Discrete Math.'', its publisher and contributors frequently use the shorter abbreviation ''SIDMA''.
